title: Node state (gateway → cloud)
description: Topics pigdetector/{deviceId}/state (live) and pigdetector/{deviceId}/recovered (held during an outage, sent later with its original ts). The gateway copies the node's JSON and adds only ts. Unknown keys are ignored.

status.description: What the node reports, without deviceId and type. Reused by pd_latest, the API's latest and history items.

openSec.description: Door nodes only. Counts up while open, 0 when closed or just opened.

tempC.description: Temperature nodes only, 2 decimals. null if the probe failed (a DS18B20 fault reads −127 or 85).

limits.description: The limits the node is really using.

ack.description: cmdId of the last command handled. Stays until the next command.

ackErr.description: null if that command worked, auto_mode for setLed in auto, invalid for anything else.

door.description: A door node sends door fields and never the temperature ones, so a mixed message is a firmware bug.

openMaxSec.description: Door: seconds open before the LED turns on in auto. Firmware starts at 30.

tempMaxC.description: Temp: °C above which the LED turns on in auto. Firmware starts at 4.4.
